newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-NORTHERN TRANSVAAL BEAT CANTERBURY 23-22.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NORTHERN TRANSVAAL BEAT CANTERBURY 23-22.

text.p: Northern Transvaal beat the Canterbury Crusaders 23-22 (halftime 17-17) in their Super 12 match at Loftus Versfeld on Saturday.
Northern Transvaal - Tries: Boeta Wessels, Johan Schutte. Conversions: Casper Steyn (2). Penalties: Steyn (3).
Canterbury - Tries: Steve Surridge, Afato Sooalo (2). Conversions: Daryl Lilley (2). Penalties: Andrew Mehrtens.
